description: Reads the Live app's day-by-day revenue and top products between from (inclusive) and before (exclusive), both YYYY-MM-DD, at most 180 days at a time — refund-aware, per currency, from Gemmein's own stored payment events, never a live Stripe call. Also answers churn for the period (subscriptions cancelled, active at the start, the rate) when there is one to compute. The same finer-grained numbers the dashboard's Payments chart reads; live_revenue's own read is the coarser monthly aggregate. live:read; audited; changes nothing. This is what a founder may call their revenue chart or sales trend.
name: live_revenue_trend
title: Live: revenue trend
